common_rules.pairing: LOW and HIGH for the identical frozen template; block by repository, task class, difficulty and order
common_rules.missing: never impute; report reason and condition
common_rules.blocked: excluded from effect numerator but retained in planned denominator and blockage decision
common_rules.censoring: retain stopping-limit time as right-censored; do not treat as event or pass
common_rules.aggregation: report repository x task-class x difficulty first; pooling cannot override opposite strata
common_rules.minimum_effect_basis: Frozen protocol values, not chosen for 128 executions

estimands.name: acceptance-yield effect
estimands.numerator: accepted HIGH/classifiable HIGH minus accepted LOW/classifiable LOW
estimands.denominator: classifiable randomized executions by condition; planned denominator also shown
estimands.aggregation: paired risk difference, stratum then cohort
estimands.uncertainty: paired template-cluster bootstrap 95% interval; Wilson condition intervals

estimands.name: all-gates-valid throughput effect
estimands.denominator: total active operator minutes by condition
estimands.aggregation: HIGH minus LOW throughput, stratum first
estimands.minimum_scientifically_meaningful_effect: 15% relative improvement and CI lower bound >0

estimands.name: time-to-valid effect
estimands.numerator: HIGH minus LOW minutes to first valid result
estimands.denominator: one paired contrast per pair with event/censor status
estimands.aggregation: paired survival contrast/restricted mean through 8 hours; descriptive paired mean in rehearsal
estimands.minimum_scientifically_meaningful_effect: 15% relative reduction; amendment makes this explicit for design only

estimands.name: implementation binding change
estimands.unit: repository x task-class stratum and condition
estimands.numerator: S05 satisfies candidate AND binding clause for failure or throughput
estimands.aggregation: boolean per frozen type; LOW true AND HIGH false
estimands.uncertainty: frozen replay/bootstrap CI embedded in binding evidence

estimands.name: non-implementation replacement binding
estimands.unit: repository x task-class stratum and condition
estimands.numerator: named S01-S04/S06-S12 newly satisfies candidate AND binding clauses in HIGH
estimands.aggregation: stage and type retained; no any-stage pooling

estimands.name: first-failure-stage distribution shift
estimands.numerator: count first failures at each S01-S12 or NONE
estimands.uncertainty: paired cluster bootstrap simultaneous intervals; Holm family
estimands.minimum_scientifically_meaningful_effect: 0.10 absolute shift for a prespecified stage

estimands.name: repository/task interactions
estimands.unit: task-template pair nested in repository and task class
estimands.numerator: difference in paired condition effects between repository/task-class levels
estimands.aggregation: condition x repository and condition x task class; difficulty/order adjusted
estimands.uncertainty: Holm-adjusted 95% intervals; opposite intervals qualify domain dependence
estimands.minimum_scientifically_meaningful_effect: 0.10 yield or 15% throughput difference between levels
